ogre-registry-recent-app
========================

.. tip:: Ingestion into Splunk.

   **``windows:ogre:registry_recent_app``**

   * name_rex: ``\.jsonl$``
   * path_suffix: ``ogre-registry-recent-app``
   * sourcetype: ``windows:ogre:registry_recent_app``
   * host_rex: ``([\w\.-]+?)--``
   * artifact: ``hive``
   * timestamp_path: ``timestamp``
   * timestamp_format: ``%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z``

-----------

Parsing of recent\_app - using ANSSI DFIR OGRE
